poster_title: One SPACE to Rule Them All: Jointly Mitigating Factuality and Faithfulness Hallucinations in LLMs
authors: Pengbo Wang, Chaozhuo Li, Chenxu Wang, Liwen Zheng, Litian Zhang, Xi Zhang
paper_info: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Shihezi University, 2023

panels.headline: Persistent hallucinations hinder practical deployment of LLMs.
content: LLMs excel in natural language processing.
Factuality and faithfulness hallucinations are major obstacles.
Current interventions often lead to performance trade-offs.
Existing methods address hallucinations independently, which is suboptimal.
Propose SPACE to mitigate both types of hallucinations simultaneously.

panels.headline: SPACE edits shared activation subspaces for joint improvement.
content: Formalize the intersection of activation patterns through dual-task feature modeling.
Use a hybrid probe strategy combining spectral clustering and attention head saliency scoring.
panels.figure_caption: Activation Distributions of Factual and Faithful Tasks. Subfigure (a) shows the proportion of disjoint and interwoven activation pattern after training. Subfigure (b) and (c) show two cases of disjoint activation pattern and interwoven activation pattern respectfully.

panels.headline: Conducted on TruthfulQA and PDTB datasets.
content: Evaluate performance using DISQ for faithfulness.
Compare SPACE with SOTA baselines on both datasets.
Analyze the impact of editing shared subspaces on model performance.
panels.figure_caption: Cross-model comparison of editing methods on TruthfulQA and PDTB with DISQ evaluation.

panels.headline: SPACE outperforms SOTA baselines in mitigating hallucinations.
content: Editing shared subspaces improves both factuality and faithfulness.
SPACE maintains or enhances model performance without trade-offs.
panels.figure_caption: Ablation study of SPACE on LLaMA-2-7B-Chat: dark green bars indicate original performance, light green bars indicate performance after removing key components; 'Fact.' refers to True*Info % (TruthfulQA), 'Faith.' refers to DISQ Overall % (PDTB).

panels.headline: SPACE identifies and edits critical subspace-contributing heads.
content: Theoretical evidence supports the effectiveness of targeting shared activation subspaces.
Empirical results validate the joint improvement in factuality and faithfulness.
panels.figure_caption: Illustrative success cases showing how SPACE improves factuality and faithfulness.

panels.headline: SPACE provides a promising solution for hallucination mitigation.
content: Theoretical and empirical evidence supports the effectiveness of SPACE.
Future work will focus on improving the precision of subspace editing.
SPACE can be applied to other LLMs and tasks to enhance reliability.
The framework has potential for broader impact in natural language processing.
Further research is needed to address the limitations of shared subspace editing.
